examples.description: Record the portal-assigned UUID after the owner's portal entry

failure_modes.recovery: Call myinvois_invoice_list to find a valid id.
failure_modes.when: the id does not name an e-invoice in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Record the UUID on the original invoice instead.
failure_modes.when: the document is not a type-01 original — credit/debit/refund notes never carry their own portal UUID

preconditions: lhdn_uuid is the identifier the LHDN MyInvois portal assigned after the owner's own entry on the portal; Simpler never calls the LHDN API.

description: Record the UUID the LHDN MyInvois portal assigned after the owner keyed this e-invoice into the portal (its form or LHDN's Excel batch template). Simpler never submits to LHDN and never calls the MyInvois API; this only stores the UUID the owner copies back. Only a type-01 original accepts a UUID: credit, debit and refund notes are refused (they link through BillingReference), so record the UUID on the original instead. Moves status generated to submitted; calling it again on a submitted invoice corrects a mistyped UUID. NEXT: myinvois_invoice_read to see the UUID attached.

id.description: The myinvois_invoice id to record the LHDN UUID against (myinvois_invoice_list shows them).

name: myinvois_invoice_record_submission
